subject: Compliance add-ons: pricing & bundled discount request
summary: Negotiation over bundled pricing for audit logs, KMS/HSM, and data residency. Customer requests a stacked discount for HIPAA + dedicated HSM. Sales loops in finance and security for one-time concession and procurement next steps.
messages:
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@acme-robotics.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood compliance add-ons — pricing clarification and discount?

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — the latency and cost numbers look promising. Our security team did a quick pass and asked for formal pricing for the following add-ons so we can move this through procurement:

- Continuous audit logs (7y retention option)
- Customer-managed keys (KMS) + HSM option for key storage
- Data residency: US-only (multi-region isolation)
- HIPAA add-on / BA agreement (we are subject to PHI in one product line)

Two specific asks: can you provide line-item pricing and a bundled price if we take HIPAA + HSM together? Procurement also asked whether you can offer a one-time implementation discount for the onboarding month.

We are targeting a July go-live if numbers look good.

Thanks,
Alex Turner
Head of Cloud Platform
Acme Robotics

---
Attachment: requirements_acme_security_v1.docx (attachment referenced, not included)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@acme-robotics.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 12:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood compliance add-ons — pricing clarification and discount?

Alex — great to hear from you and glad the demo helped.

Below is a concise breakdown (ballpark) and then a proposed bundled concession we can discuss with Finance: 

- Audit logs (standard): $0.015 / GB-month retained (30/90/365 day Tiers); 7-year retention moves to archival tier at $0.005 / GB-month.
- KMS (managed keys): $1,200 / month for customer-managed KMS integration (including key rotation hooks).
- HSM (dedicated): $8,500 / month for a dedicated HSM-backed key store (e.g., FIPS 140-2 level) — recommended for regulated PHI workloads.
- Data residency (US-only): $2,500 / month premium to reserve regional pools + per-token routing guarantee.
- HIPAA add-on + BA: $3,000 / month + one-time BA execution fee ($1,500) — includes attestation, annual review.

Bundled ask: if you take HIPAA add-on + HSM dedicated together we can offer a bundled price: 15% off the combined list for the first 12 months (requires 12-month commit).

Implementation/onboarding discount: Sales can propose a one-time credit equivalent to 1 month of the bundle if you sign a 12-month reserved contract within 30 days.

I'm attaching a draft compliance pricing PDF and our SOC2 evidence checklist so your security team has the mapping. Numbers above are draft — I will loop in Markus for formal approval if you want to proceed.

Next steps: if you want the approved commercial spreadsheet, I can put Markus on a short call or route a formal quote via DocuSign.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0189

Attachments: redwood_compliance_pricing_v3.pdf, SOC2_evidence_checklist.xlsx

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@acme-robotics.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood compliance add-ons — pricing clarification and discount?

Rishi — thanks for the quick breakdown and attachments. A few clarifying Qs from procurement/security: 

1) For the HSM price, is that per HSM cluster or per customer? We will need a dedicated cluster per environment (prod + staging).
2) The 15% bundled discount — can that be increased if we commit to 24 months?
3) The onboarding credit is helpful — can that be applied toward the BA execution fee instead of the monthly invoice? Procurement prefers credits that offset signed one-time fees.

We're close; a tighter discount on the bundle would make the internal finance review easier. Can you loop in finance? Otherwise, send the DocuSign quote and we'll start internal approvals.

Cheers,
Alex

Alex — looping in Markus (Finance) and Kim (Security & Compliance) to confirm structure. Answers inline: 

1) HSM pricing: listed price is per dedicated HSM instance/cluster. So prod + staging would be 2x the HSM monthly line. We can also offer a shared staging option at 50% cost if Acme can accept logical separation and an SLA carve-out.

2) Bundled discount: Markus — can we consider escalating the bundle to 20% for a 24-month commit? The customer is asking and they are close to a July go-live.

3) Onboarding credit: can be applied to BA execution fee, yes — Sales is fine with crediting the one-time BA fee instead of monthly invoice, subject to contract language.

Markus/Kim — quick call today or a short thread reply would be ideal; procurement wants formal numbers by end of day.

Thanks,
Rishi

Rishi / Alex — I reviewed the ask. Finance is comfortable approving the following concession for Acme Robotics given the projected scale and the strategic instantiation: 

- Bundled concession: 20% off combined list price for HIPAA add-on + HSM (first 24 months) if Acme signs a 24-month reserved contract (deal_id RDW-ACME-2026-07).
- HSM pricing: charged per dedicated cluster; we will provide a shared-staging option at 50% if Acme wants to reduce cost (must be documented in SOW).
- BA execution fee: waive $1,500 BA fee and apply Sales onboarding credit to the BA fee as requested (one-time).
- To secure the concession, we require: a signed 24-month SOW, commitment to annual security review (included), and standard invoice terms (Net 30).

Kimberly (Security): please confirm the shared-staging option is permissible and whether we need additional wording in the BA.

Alex — if that sounds good I can push the formal quote through DocuSign this afternoon.

Regards,
